/- Let b be a real number randomly selected from the interval $[-17,17]$. Then, m and n are two relatively prime positive integers such that m/n is the probability that the equation $x^4+25b^2=(4b^2-10b)x^2$ has $\textit{at least}$ two distinct real solutions. Find the value of $m+n$.
 -/
theorem algebra_13294 (b : ℝ) (hb : b ∈ Set.Icc (-17) 17) :
    ∃ m n : ℕ, m > 0 ∧ n > 0 ∧ Nat.Coprime m n ∧
      (∃ x1 x2 : ℝ, x1 ≠ x2 ∧ x1^4 + 25 * b^2 = (4 * b^2 - 10 * b) * x1^2 ∧
        x2^4 + 25 * b^2 = (4 * b^2 - 10 * b) * x2^2) ↔ m + n = 63 := by

        x2^4 + 25 * b^2 = (4 * b^2 - 10 * b) * x2^2) ↔ m + n = 63 := by

    by_cases h : b < 0 ∨ b > 5 ∨ b = 5
    · -- Case: b < 0 ∨ b > 5 ∨ b = 5
      use 1, 62
      have h₁ : (1 : ℕ) > 0 := by norm_num
      have h₂ : (62 : ℕ) > 0 := by norm_num

            | inl h₅ =>
              -- Case: b > 5
              nlinarith

theorem algebra_311218 {p q : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hq : 0 < q)

    q / p = (1 + Real.sqrt 5) / 2 := by
  have h₁ : ∃ (x : ℝ), Real.log p / Real.log 9 = x ∧ Real.log q / Real.log 12 = x ∧ Real.log (p + q) / Real.log 16 = x := by

    refine' ⟨x, _⟩
    constructor
    · -- Prove Real.log p / Real.log 9 = x
      have h₂ : Real.logb 9 p = x := hx₁
      have h₃ : Real.logb 9 p = Real.log p / Real.log 9 := by
        rw [Real.logb]
        <;> field_simp [Real.log_mul, Real.log_rpow, Real.log_pow, hp.ne', Real.log_ne_zero_of_pos_of_ne_one (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 9) (by norm_num : (9 : ℝ) ≠ 1)]
      rw [h₃] at h₂
      linarith
    · constructor
      · -- Prove Real.log q / Real.log 12 = x
        have h₂ : Real.logb 12 q = x := hx₂
        have h₃ : Real.logb 12 q = Real.log q / Real.log 12 := by
          rw [Real.logb]
          <;> field_simp [Real.log_mul, Real.log_rpow, Real.log_pow, hq.ne', Real.log_ne_zero_of_pos_of_ne_one (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 12) (by norm_num : (12 : ℝ) ≠ 1)]
        rw [h₃] at h₂
        linarith
      · -- Prove Real.log (p + q) / Real.log 16 = x
        have h₂ : Real.logb 16 (p + q) = x := hx₃
        have h₃ : Real.logb 16 (p + q) = Real.log (p + q) / Real.log 16 := by
          rw [Real.logb]
          <;> field_simp [Real.log_mul, Real.log_rpow, Real.log_pow, (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < p + q), Real.log_ne_zero_of_pos_of_ne_one (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 16) (by norm_num : (16 : ℝ) ≠ 1)]
        rw [h₃] at h₂
        linarith
  
  have h₂ : ∃ (x : ℝ), Real.log p = x * Real.log 9 ∧ Real.log q = x * Real.log 12 ∧ Real.log (p + q) = x * Real.log 16 := by
    obtain ⟨x, hx₁, hx₂, hx₃⟩ := h₁
    refine' ⟨x, _, _, _⟩
    · -- Prove Real.log p = x * Real.log 9
      have h₃ : Real.log p / Real.log 9 = x := hx₁
      have h₄ : Real.log 9 ≠ 0 := by
        -- Prove that the logarithm of 9 is not zero
        have h₅ : Real.log 9 > 0 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
        linarith
      -- Solve for Real.log p
      have h₅ : Real.log p = x * Real.log 9 := by
        field_simp [h₄] at h₃ ⊢
        <;> nlinarith
      exact h₅
    · -- Prove Real.log q = x * Real.log 12
      have h₃ : Real.log q / Real.log 12 = x := hx₂
      have h₄ : Real.log 12 ≠ 0 := by
        -- Prove that the logarithm of 12 is not zero
        have h₅ : Real.log 12 > 0 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
        linarith
      -- Solve for Real.log q
      have h₅ : Real.log q = x * Real.log 12 := by
        field_simp [h₄] at h₃ ⊢
        <;> nlinarith
      exact h₅
    · -- Prove Real.log (p + q) = x * Real.log 16
      have h₃ : Real.log (p + q) / Real.log 16 = x := hx₃
      have h₄ : Real.log 16 ≠ 0 := by
        -- Prove that the logarithm of 16 is not zero
        have h₅ : Real.log 16 > 0 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
        linarith
      -- Solve for Real.log (p + q)
      have h₅ : Real.log (p + q) = x * Real.log 16 := by
        field_simp [h₄] at h₃ ⊢
        <;> nlinarith
      exact h₅
  
  have h₃ : ∃ (y : ℝ), y > 0 ∧ Real.log (1 + y) = 2 * Real.log y := by
